$comment: Declared-expected skips, shared by every lane that runs scripts/acceptance/verify-tests.py with --fail-on-unknown-skip (test.yml unit/integration/E2E steps, coverage.yml pkg lane, ci-integration.yml). An entry here is an EXCEPTION, not a default: the verifier fails any lane whose skip is not listed. Plan §7.2 permits explicit exceptions with a reason for skips outside the repository's promised surface, but forbids using them to cover chain correctness, security, or a required adapter. Every new entry names the lane that produces it, a category, and the measured skip message. An entry whose lane no longer produces the skip is inert, not a failure.
